messages:
Priya Singh: Quick sync: Gate for CrossRun adapter v0.9 looks close but we hit a streaming/KV edge with LlamaIndex. Need decision on whether to block marketplace listing.
Darren Cole: Can you paste the failing trace?
Leah Kim: Repro log (trimmed):
```
2026-04-22T15:02:03Z ERROR gateway: stream handshake timeout for adapter=crossrun-v0.9 conn=18
2026-04-22T15:02:03Z WARN runtime: falling back to non-stream path; kv-shard 4 incomplete
```
Leah Kim: Short desc: adapter requests 1024-token streaming chunks, our runtime expects 256 and does eager KV hydration. With sharded indices this causes memory spike + p95 jump.
Sam - Integrations: I hit same locally. Repro steps:
```
export REDWOOD_KEY=xxx
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/gateway/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"adapter":"crossrun-v0.9","flow":"llamaindex-shard","model":"llama-7b","stream":true,"input":"find docs about billing"}'
```
Sam - Integrations: Result = stream degraded into buffer flush, ~2.5s extra latency.
Tess - Marketplace: Marketing wants to list them next week. Is there a minimal compatibility label we can show if not fully green?
Priya Singh: We could show "Beta-compatible: partial streaming" but that risks poor customer experience. Prefer gating until streaming handshake is stable.
Darren Cole: Suggest a short-term mitigation: runtime accepts larger chunk headers but negotiates a smaller effective chunk (server-side clamp). That avoids eager KV hydrations. Is that feasible?
Leah Kim: Feasible. I can add server-side clamp to 256 tokens in the gateway negotiation layer. Quick patch will be a config flag so we don't change other adapters.
Marta (Partner PM): Partner asks for timeline. If we can fix within 3 business days we'll keep the planned joint blog. Otherwise they want to postpone.
integrations-bot: CI run #4978 for branch crossrun-fix started.
Sam - Integrations: I've opened an issue in their repo and proposed the chunk-header change too: crossrun/crossrun#92.
Priya Singh: Lina, legal: do we need any change to the partner addendum if we list as beta-compatible?
Lina Legal: If we label as Beta-compatible, add a short disclaimer paragraph in the marketplace listing and update the SLA section to show "best-effort streaming" for that adapter. I can draft text by 2026-04-25.
Darren Cole: OK, plan: Leah implements server-side clamp + unit test. Sam prepares sample terraform + onboarding snippet to include in marketplace assets. Marta holds marketing copy until perf numbers.
Leah Kim: I'll push a PR today (gateway: clamp-stream-chunk, tests) and run H100/A10G smoke tests tomorrow morning.
Priya Singh: Can everyone acknowledge action items and dates?
Darren Cole: I'll review PR + provide eng quote by 2026-04-25.
Sam - Integrations: Terraform + runbook by 2026-04-24.
Marta (Partner PM): Draft co-announcement copy + screenshot ask to CrossRun by 2026-04-26.
Tess - Marketplace: I'll add a draft badge option: "Beta-compatible (streaming: best-effort)" and hold until legal ok.
integrations-bot: CI run #4978 finished: tests failed in streaming-handshake unit tests.
Leah Kim: Noted failing test, investigating. Might be race on connection teardown. Will post update in the morning. :coffee:
Priya Singh: Thanks. If Leah's fix lands and smoke passes on H100/A10G by EOD 2026-04-24 we can proceed with marketplace beta listing and joint blog the week of 2026-05-11. If not, we delay the announcement.
Marta (Partner PM): Copy that. I'll prepare a contingency social plan for a delayed announce.
Priya Singh: End of thread summary:
- Implement gateway clamp for stream chunks (Leah) -> PR and tests 2026-04-23
- Run HW smoke on H100/A10G (Leah) -> results 2026-04-24
- Terraform + onboarding runbook (Sam) -> 2026-04-24
- Legal draft disclaimer & SLA language (Lina) -> 2026-04-25
- Draft co-announcement + screenshots (Marta) -> 2026-04-26
- Marketplace badge draft (Tess) -> hold until legal ok
- Engineering quote + perf blurb (Darren) -> 2026-04-25

Priya Singh: Tagging followups: @Leah Kim @Sam - Integrations @Lina Legal @Marta (Partner PM)
Leah Kim: Will update with CI fix status tomorrow.
